notes: Corrections demandées après revue des images réellement produites, sans écraser les originaux.
Priorité de Kusaila : chaque objet doit être entièrement visible, y compris les supports et les extrémités ; ne pas confondre gros plan et asset complet.
Les nouvelles images restent des candidates jusqu'à la revue visuelle. Le journal enregistre la génération, pas une approbation de design.
Trois requêtes simultanées maximum, aucune relance automatique. Les vues du robot repartent exclusivement du maître aux yeux bleus.

jobs.name: 08-verrou-contention-complet-v2
jobs.prompt: Recreate the attached restraint-lock product as ONE COMPLETE standalone assembly, photographed from farther away. The previous picture incorrectly cuts off its support: correct that defect. Show BOTH finished ends of the short off-white armrest mounting section, its complete underside, dark ridged rotary knob, hinge and curved wrist clamp. The entire assembly must fit within the central 65 percent of the square canvas, leaving at least 15 percent empty margin on EVERY side. Nothing touches an image edge. Infer a simple compact end cap for the previously cropped support; do not extend it into a whole chair. Preserve the existing knob and clamp design and their mechanically connected construction. Front three-quarter view, neutral diffuse product lighting, crisp readable geometry. Completely replace the background with a solid uniform light gray. No residual room, floor equipment, ghost images, robot, wrist, whole chair, extra object, labels or exploded parts. One complete product, not a detail crop.

jobs.name: 03-robot-back-v2
jobs.prompt: Rotate the camera around the attached robot by 180 degrees to show its exact BACK. The robot faces directly AWAY from the viewer. Show the plain back of its gray cranial shell, the rear neck and mechanical spine, backs of both arms and legs, heels. NO eyes, facial mask, chest port or cyan optics visible from behind. Do not put another face or glowing eyes on the rear of the skull. Preserve the master's slender skeletal construction, limb proportions, joints, hand structure and relaxed A-pose. Infer unseen rear construction minimally, with no backpack or new accessories. Full body, head, all fingers and both feet inside frame with generous margin. Straight rear near-orthographic production view, neutral diffuse light, uniform light-gray studio background. One robot, one view, no chair, scene, labels or panels. This is a reference drawing in realistic materials, not a claim of measured multiview geometry.

jobs.name: 04-robot-left-profile-v2
jobs.prompt: Show this exact robot from its anatomical LEFT side in a strict 90-degree side elevation. The robot's nose points toward the RIGHT EDGE of the image. The visible left temple, left shoulder and left hip are aligned in profile; do not show a front three-quarter chest or two eyes. Preserve the existing small cyan left optic, gray facial shell, slim ribbed dark chest, mechanical hands, limb lengths and relaxed A-pose of the attached authoritative master. Rotate the viewpoint only; do not redesign, add equipment or mirror an existing generated view. The far limbs can be partially occluded naturally. Entire body including head, all fingertips and both feet, with generous empty margins. Near-orthographic camera, uniform light-gray background, neutral diffuse lighting. One robot and one side view, no chair, labels, montage or environment.

jobs.name: 09-module-avant-bras-isole-v2
jobs.prompt: Create a clean isolated product reference of ONLY the forearm maintenance component in the attachment. Retain its dark skeletal construction, partly open gray access panel, intact connected cable bundle and small separate lodged metal obstruction. Preserve the object identity, but show the COMPLETE component with both mechanical end fittings visible and at least 15 percent clear margin around it. Replace ALL surrounding pixels with a uniform light-gray studio background; completely remove the residual scene, chair, reflections and ghosted shapes underneath. Neutral diffuse light, crisp component details, one front three-quarter view. No robot body, detached hand, extra tool, room, floor equipment, text, frame or exploded-view parts. It must read as one complete independently modelable component, not a cutout floating over the original room.

jobs.name: 10-decor-vide-propre-v2
jobs.prompt: Reconstruct this exact clinical room completely EMPTY. Keep the camera direction, pale wall panels, ceiling luminaires, dark horizontal observation mirror, rear door and floor structure. Remove the robot, entire chair, tool stand, every loose tool and every cable associated with those removed objects. Rebuild the newly exposed wall and floor as clean continuous surfaces with straight consistent panel seams and natural lighting. Absolutely no blurry erased silhouette, smeared patch, ghost chair, duplicate room fragment or painted remnant in the center or foreground. The result is one coherent finished empty-room photograph, not an inpainting demonstration. All room surfaces remain opaque. Preserve the approved stark clinical art direction and neutral white illumination. No new furniture, signage, people, robot, collage or text. This is a 16:9 room reference, not a panorama or playable scene.

jobs.name: 16-miroir-observation-isole-v2
jobs.prompt: Extract and redraw ONLY the complete long dark observation-mirror assembly from this attachment as a standalone product. Keep its very wide shallow off-white rectangular frame and smoked dark glass. Show all four corners and shallow mounting depth in a mild three-quarter view. The mirror occupies no more than 70 percent of the image width, with ample uniform light-gray background on every side. Remove the entire room, wall, floor, robot and chair; no trace or ghost of them may remain below or inside the object. Glass is nearly uniform charcoal with only a restrained neutral studio reflection, not a painted scene. Neutral diffuse product lighting. One complete mirror assembly, no mounting wall slab, supporting stand, labels, text, collage or other objects. The actual reflection is to be produced in the game, not baked into this image.

jobs.name: 21-module-route-enfer-isole-v2
jobs.prompt: Recreate ONLY the complete three-lane floor module shown in the attachment as a clean standalone product. Preserve the rectangular graphite steel slab, three flat equal-width lanes, recessed longitudinal strips, shallow structural underside and muted red edge details. Show both connection ends, all corners and the full underside edge with at least 15 percent empty margin on every side. Elevated three-quarter view. Completely discard the attached image's background, especially the residual chair and room fragment below the module. The backdrop must be an uninterrupted solid light gray with no scenery, horizon, floor machinery, ghost image or pasted source. Neutral diffuse light. No obstacles, guardrails, extra modules, text or characters. The one slab must be isolated and unobstructed for reconstruction; gameplay dimensions remain defined by the developer.

jobs.name: 23-barre-glissade-isole-v2
jobs.prompt: Recreate ONLY the complete slide-under gantry in the attachment. Keep the graphite frame, two side posts, thick raised horizontal beam, pale inset panels and subdued red safety accents. Both entire support feet and the full top beam must be visible with 15 percent margin on every side. The low passage under the beam is genuinely empty, showing the same plain light-gray background as outside the object. Remove ALL residual scene imagery, floor structure, chair shapes or ghosted fragments under and behind the gantry. Neutral diffuse studio light, readable front three-quarter angle, crisp edges. No person, ground slab, pedestal, additional machine, lettering, arrows or collage. One connected complete assembly, with a clear empty opening for sliding.

jobs.name: 27-orbe-energie-isole-v2
jobs.prompt: Redraw ONLY the single energy collectible in the attachment, with its cyan glass core and segmented pale ceramic-metal arcs. Preserve its existing design and contained inner emission. Center the complete object within the central 60 percent of the square canvas, leaving wide empty margins. Replace the background entirely with solid uniform light gray. Remove the ghosted room, robot, chair and any reflection of a scene below or inside the sphere. No cast environment, floor, pedestal, extra sphere or disconnected accessory. Neutral diffuse product lighting; emission is restrained so the silhouette and all arcs stay sharp. One standalone collectible, no text, symbols, panels or montage. This is a shape/material reference, not an animation.
